name: sfwms-monorepo
description: CityMart - Smart Food Warehouse Management System (SFWMS)

scripts.backend:build: concurrently "npm run build -w backend/services/user-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/product-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/inventory-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/order-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/warehouse-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/outbound-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/inbound-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/report-service" "npm run build -w backend/services/transport-service"
scripts.backend:fast: concurrently -n "USER,PROD,ORD,INV,WH,OUT,IN,REP,TRANS" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,gray,white,blueBright" "npm run user:prod" "npm run product:prod" "npm run order:prod" "npm run inventory:prod" "npm run warehouse:prod" "npm run outbound:prod" "npm run inbound:prod" "npm run report:prod" "npm run transport:prod"
scripts.backend:dev:order: concurrently -n "USER,PROD,ORDER-DEV,INV,WH,OUT,IN,REP,TRANS" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,gray,white,blueBright" "npm run user:prod" "npm run product:prod" "npm run order:start" "npm run inventory:prod" "npm run warehouse:prod" "npm run outbound:prod" "npm run inbound:prod" "npm run report:prod" "npm run transport:prod"
scripts.backend:dev:sales: concurrently -n "USER,PROD,ORDER-DEV,INV" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta" "npm run user:prod" "npm run product:prod" "npm run order:start" "npm run inventory:prod"
scripts.backend:staff: concurrently -n "USER,OUTBOUND,PRODUCT,INVENTORY,INBOUND" -c "blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan" "npm run user:start" "npm run outbound:start" "npm run product:start" "npm run inventory:start" "npm run inbound:start"
scripts.backend:admin: concurrently -n "WAREHOUSE,ORDER,REPORT,TRANSPORT" -c "red,blue,green,yellow" "npm run warehouse:start" "npm run order:start" "npm run report:start" "npm run transport:start"
scripts.backend:all: concurrently "npm run user:start" "npm run product:start" "npm run order:start" "npm run inventory:start" "npm run warehouse:start" "npm run outbound:start" "npm run inbound:start" "npm run report:start" "npm run transport:start"
